description: Compact Sonos subwoofer. It is bonded to a Sonos soundbar and has no media_player entity of its own, so add it manually and select the soundbar's media_player as the source: the sub plays when the bar plays and follows the bar's volume.
measure_description: Measured manually with a Shelly Plus Plug UK on the Sub Mini's own mains lead (230 V UK), polling its Switch.GetStatus apower every 2 s and averaging 20 s per volume step. The sub was bonded to a Sonos Beam (sub enabled, gain -1); the calibration keys are the BEAM's volume, stepped 0-100 % while playing a bass-heavy track (Massive Attack - Angel) streamed to the Beam over AirPlay by Music Assistant. The Beam's own volume_level was confirmed at every step, and the plug was verified to feed the sub: switched off, the Beam's live ZoneGroupTopology lost its SW satellite; switched back on, it rejoined. The draw stayed flat at 5.69-5.87 W across the whole range (a quieter track at 14 % and 40 % read 5.79 W). Paused/idle: 5.62 W. Unlike the Sub (Gen 1) and Sub 4 profiles there is no rise at high volume in this setup.
name: Sub Mini
